exposure: pattern of respiratory modality used (invasive vs. non-invasive)
cohort: The study included 200 preterm newborns admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital.
finding: Respiratory distress syndrome was identified as the commonest cause of respiratory distress, and newborns who required invasive respiratory support experienced significantly higher short-term morbidities, retinopathy of prematurity, and mortality.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 1665.43+/-585.58 g, with 42% classified as very low birth weight.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was 32.46+/-2.58 weeks, with 64% of newborns between 28 and less than 34 weeks.
